children: United Community Banks completed the sale of Navitas for approximately $2.0 billion in cash, yielding a 7% premium to par.
Completed sale of Navitas Credit Corp. and NLFC Reinsurance Corp. to funds managed by Wafra for ~$2.0B in cash.
Transaction represents a 7% premium to the par value of Navitas’ loan portfolio, an attractive monetization.
Sale reinforces focus on core Southeastern relationship banking and simplifies the company’s business model.
Proceeds are expected to enhance United’s liquidity and capital strength.
